title: University Overview
content: Sanjivani University is an institution of higher education established on the 40th anniversary of the Sanjivani Rural Education Society. The university emphasizes academic rigor, innovation, research, global cooperation, industry interaction, and student development. Its academic offerings include Engineering and Technology, Commerce and Management, Social Science and Humanities, School of Sciences, School of Pharmaceutical Science, School of Foreign Languages, School of Interdisciplinary Studies, undergraduate and postgraduate programmes, and global leadership programmes.

title: Centres of Excellence
content: The university website reports that Fortinet partnered with Sanjivani University to establish a Fortinet Centre of Excellence on August 28, 2024. It also reports the inauguration of an IBM Centre of Excellence on January 23, 2025. These initiatives are presented as supporting cybersecurity education, industry-relevant training, real-world project experience, technological skills, industry readiness, and innovation.

title: Academic Environment
content: The university presents its academic environment as a community of scholars, students, and alumni focused on learning, innovation, research, and social impact. Its stated approach combines academic excellence with practical teaching, industry interaction, international cooperation, entrepreneurship, communication skills, and opportunities for professional development.
